featured_reviews.name: Aviraj Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a lovely family-run restaurant. The food is simple and has that comforting homemade taste you don’t find everywhere.

We often order takeaway from here, and it’s always consistently good. You can really feel the care and warmth they put into both the food and service.

A great place if you’re looking for homely, satisfying meals!

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was introduced to this small, family-run Maharashtrian restaurant by a family member.  Seating is limited (2 tables, around 10 chairs). There is wash basin on site but no washroom.

The Baigan Bharta is their signature dish. Highly recommended. We tried a couple of their thaalis. Bhangda, Bombil, Chicken and Vegetarian.The highlight of the meal was the inclusion of kardi with all thalis, a unique touch that makes it worth it.

The portions are pretty good, making it easy to share a thali between two people (with a medium appetite).

UPDATE: The Gawar Bhaji was a gravy, which I didn't find appealing. I also found that it lacked  coconut. This dish didn't tick the box for me.

While the menu may seem limited to some, the quality of the food is exceptional. For dessert,  ice cream is available at MRP.

We visited this place twice so far.

featured_reviews.name: sushant awalekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We went by checking the google reviews and it was disappointing experience

Please check the charges before you order and always ask for a bill.
Otherwise, Vivek and his mother tend to calculate amounts as they wish, which can lead to overcharging (they did to us).
• Taste is okay, nothing exceptional.
• Ask if it’s freshly prepared. They simply reheat leftover items, which they even mention in their “Sakalichi Kame” list displayed at the hotel.

Overall, not recommended if you are expecting genuine homemade-style food.

featured_reviews.name: henry martin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food was too good and reasonable.
It is a family run business and everyone was polite and good to talk to.
We had veg and non veg thali and all of us including my kids enjoyed the food.
They offered us free dish made of brinjal which was their hot running item.

Seating is limited to just 2 tables accommodating around 8 people.
